criteria.reason: Names both values—family faith versus equal inclusive education—and explains the weighing clearly.
Accommodation-first compromise: separate classes plus parallel curriculum route; dignity preserved via non-stigmatising framing and trial period.
Respectful of family's faith, school's mission, and pupil throughout; no personal critiques.
Defers to canton and school head but omits BGE 135 I 79 and cites unverifiable Aargau policy.
